thread.title: UK's Labour PM Starmer Must Embrace Trump's Free-Speech Agenda and Repeal Censorship Laws To Secure a Trade Deal: REPORT | The Gateway Pundit | by Paul Serran
thread.title_full: UK's Labour PM Starmer Must Embrace Trump's Free-Speech Agenda and Repeal Censorship Laws To Secure a Trade Deal: REPORT | The Gateway Pundit | by Paul Serran

author: William Sanders
text: It's not necessarily about that. It's about putting the leftist labour party leader Starmer in the position of having to either agree to Trump's demand and open up free speech in the UK that will benefit Brits AND their economy, or he will have to publicly refuse and therein hurt the UK economically in order to protect his government's rights to stifle the free speech of their citizens. This is a political maneuver for Trump more than anything else. If he can box in the leftist Starmer, Trump will either get his way, or hurt Starmer's reelection chances. And if it hurts Starmer's reelection chances and increase the chances that a more conservative right leaning PM comes into office, it would be a boon for the UK AND for Trump and the US.
